$comment: Every error code the Candle agent rail returns, grouped so an agent can decide what to do
without parsing prose. Branch on `code`, never on `message`: the code is stable, the message
is written for humans and will change.
`retryable` means the SAME request may succeed later, unchanged. Explicit error.retryable
overrides category defaults for market and transient responses. Read error.routing.reason.
Release A retains MARKET_NOT_FOUND/404 and baseline retryability; finer reasons disambiguate it.
MARKET_NOT_FOUND is deprecated on migrating surfaces; forensics retains its coverage refusal.
Source of truth is LAUNCH_ERROR_CODES in the monorepo. Coverage is asserted in CI, so a new
code cannot ship without landing in a category here.

auth.action: Fix the credential. Run `candle doctor` to tell 'no key' apart from 'wrong environment' and 'revoked'.

rate_limit.action: Back off exponentially and retry. DAILY_CAP_REACHED resets on the UTC day, so do not retry it inside the same day.

tier.action: The account's tier does not include this capability. Surface it to the owner; an agent cannot resolve it.

wallet_delegation.action: Needs a human in the browser to delegate an embedded wallet. Report exactly which chain is undelegated.

spend_policy.action: A spend limit refused the amount. Lower the amount or have the owner raise the limit. Never retry the same size.

request_validation.action: The request is malformed. Fix the named field. For TRANSACTION_TOO_LARGE the error carries the exact name-byte budget.

market.action: Read error.routing.reason and error.discovery. Explicit error.retryable overrides this default (graduation/no_candidates can retry). For a refusal from a Candle-only endpoint, request POST /api/v1/trade/agent/quote; that guidance does not promise liquidity, access or external limit orders.

sizing.action: Retry only after changing the amount or slippage. Re-quote first: repeating the same size reproduces the same failure.

token_transfer.action: Report the token left behind after the failed send. Non-transferable tokens cannot move; frozen accounts need the issuer to thaw them. For hook refusal or missing extra accounts, resolve the hook requirements and rebuild before retrying. These codes never refuse a quote.

transient.action: Honor explicit error.retryable before this default. Back off only when retryable, reusing the SAME idempotency id. hood_market_unavailable is a twice-failed address and remains retryable:false; wait for a changed condition, never spin or pause all Hood tokens. Do not reuse the id when `stage` is `executed`, or when `stage` is `unconfirmed` and `retryable` is false. An unconfirmed approval that did not send the trade has `retryable: true` and may reuse the id.

state_conflict.action: The operation already happened, or the referenced object is gone. Read current state instead of retrying, or you may pay twice. QUOTE_EXPIRED is the one entry you resolve by building again: the row is fine, its price is stale. TRADE_REVERTED spent only its network fee; trade again under a new id. REBIND_BUILD_OPEN carries retryAfter: stop the old key and rebind after it. REBIND_FORWARD_OPEN has no clock: a sign is in flight or not yet provably expired; nothing changed.

quota.action: A per-account ceiling is full. Revoke or delete something first; waiting does not help.

availability.action: The capability is switched off or a required leg is absent in this environment. Retry later; escalate if it persists.

risk_stop.action: This profile stopped itself: it reached a loss limit its owner set, or tripped its circuit breaker. Waiting does not clear it and neither does a smaller amount. Stop trading on this profile, report why, and leave it to an account owner to review and resume. GET /agent/keys/{prefix}/risk says which bound broke.

owner_stop.action: An account owner paused this profile deliberately. This is not a fault and not a limit the profile reached on its own -- nothing about the request will change it and waiting will not clear it. Stop trading on this key and say plainly that only the owner can resume it, from the agent console.
